WELCOME TO THE BLEEHIVE

Your ideas and collaboration matter more to us than your title

We believe the best ideas and the best outcomes come from us working together. Not from obeying corporate hierarchies.

‍

So whether you’re joining us remotely or in our New York or San Francisco offices, at Blee, you’ll work closely with everyone. Including our founders.

Our values



Build trust

We are in the business of trust. We go above and beyond to earn it from our customers, partners, and teammates—and we start by extending it to each other every day.



Lead with authenticity

Open, honest communication is our baseline. We bring our full, authentic selves to the table because diverse perspectives drive better outcomes.



Embrace the "it depends" ethos

Our customers operate in the gray. We push ourselves to understand context and nuances so we can see the big picture.



Empower our customers

We believe ownership drives our customers' outcomes. We roll up our sleeves because no challenge is too big and no task is too small.

BENEFITS OF WORKING AT BLEE

We take care of each other

Once you join the Bleehive, you’ll get unlimited PTO, healthcare and wellness benefits, family planning assistance, and a 401(k) match.

As well as a leader who says “yes” more than “no” to anything you need that will make your work day better.
